versions.changelog:
- Updated billing details: reduced price to 0.001 USDT (per call), added token-based billing explanation, and specified minimum recharge and withdrawal rules.
- Added three new files: BILLING-UPDATE-COMPLETE.md, _meta.json, and billing.js.
- Updated payment configuration to include skill_id and synchronize with new platform billing standards.
- Removed per_detection billing option and related descriptions; now only supports per_call billing.
- Clarified sections on pricing, minimum recharge, withdrawal, and platform fee in documentation.

Initial release – BSC Dev Wallet Monitor for automated tracking of token launches and transfers.

- Monitor specified BSC addresses for new token creation or outgoing transfers.
- Receive instant notifications via webhook when new tokens are detected.
- Includes safety checks (honeypot, liquidity) and historical activity records.
- Supports batch monitoring and custom filters (amount, symbols, exclusions).
- Flexible per-detection or per-request USDT billing.
